sn15.20:2.4: _Tivara_ is probably connected to Vedic _trivarūtha_, the “triple defence” granted devotees by the gods. By Vedic times this acquired a religious sense, but probably originated in cities. See the three defenses guarding Pokkharasāti: armed guards, walls, and moat ([dn3:2.10.11]()).
sn15.20:5.5: Note the arthasastra counts 15 muhurtas per day, and 15 per night. So “hour” is not too bad.
